Partner closely with Service, Finance, HR, Legal, Product Management, Marketing and other enabling functions to remove barriers, improve execution and make change stick. Relate credibly to executives across the Nordic and European organization when required, simplifying complex business situations into clear storylines, options, implications and recommended actions. Act as Country Lead / Managing Director for the Norwegian legal entity, including statutory and external representation where required. Contribute actively to the Nordic Leadership Team and bring a broader business perspective beyond Norway. Experience improving margin, forecast discipline, funnel quality, pricing realization and sales productivity. Ability to run what-if scenarios and translate business analysis into clear commercial decisions and execution priorities. Strong go-to-market capability, including the ability to balance direct sales, indirect channels, partners, customer segmentation and market messaging. Ability to lead through a matrix and mobilize support functions without relying only on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management internally and externally, including the confidence to engage senior executives on demand. Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex situations into clear, actionable storytelling. A structured, performance-driven leadership style with the ability to create pace, accountability and follow-through. Experience building capable teams and developing future leaders. Credibility to contribute at Nordic leadership level and potentially take on broader responsibility over time. Fluent English; Norwegian or another Scandinavian language strongly preferred. Why this role matters This is a visible and strategically important leadership role in Xylem Nordics. The business needs a leader who can build a stronger commercial platform, improve local profitability, deliver performance today, and help shape how Transport Norway contributes to the Nordic and wider European agenda over time. For the right person, the role offers the opportunity to lead a business with real market relevance, build a stronger sales engine, develop people, and contribute to an international, purpose-driven company focused on solving one of the world's most important challenges: water. Apply: Please apply in English. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. To learn more, please contact Leila Sayyad, Corporate Recruiter, at Leila.sayyad@xylem.com. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.
